# 1. Topic

This project reproduces key genomic analyses from:

<blockquote>
Hokenson RE et al. <strong>Hippocampal estrogen levels, receptor types, and epigenetics contribute to sex-specific memory vulnerabilities to concurrent acute stresses.</strong> <em>Neuron</em> 114, 1454–1472 (2026).
</blockquote>

The paper shows that stress-vulnerable mice (**males and proestrus females**) share a **permissive chromatin landscape** at estrogen receptor target gene promoters, while stress-resilient estrus females display **repressive/bivalent chromatin** at the same loci.

---

# 2. Data

Both datasets are publicly available on GEO:

| Data type | Accession |
|:---|:---|
| RNA-seq | [GSE313357](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE313357) |
| CUT&RUN-seq (H3K4me3, H3K27me3) | [GSE313359](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE313359) |

For RNA-seq we will use the processed files deposited on GEO.

For CUT&RUN, the GEO deposit contains only bigWig files, which are insufficient for ChromHMM-based bivalency and motif analyses. Reproducing Figures 3J–L will therefore require either downloading raw FASTQs from SRA and rerunning the full pipeline  *(QC → alignment → ChromHMM segmentation to obtain BED files)*  or obtaining the ChromHMM output files directly from the authors.

The authors note that "Additional information needed to reanalyze the data presented here is available from the lead contact upon request". Therefore, We will contact them as a first step.

## Experimental design

- C57BL6J mice
- 2–6 months old
- n = 3 biological replicates per group
- Hippocampal RNA and chromatin profiled from the same biological sample (S3EQ protocol)

### Groups

- Adult males
- Proestrus females
- Estrus females

---

# 3. Analyses to Reproduce

## 3.1 PCA of RNA-seq

Reproduce the PCA showing males and proestrus females clustering together (**MACS-vulnerable**) and separating clearly from estrus females (**MACS-resilient**).

---

## 3.2 DEG UpSet Plot + Volcano Plots

Pairwise DESeq2 contrasts:

- estrus vs. proestrus
- estrus vs. male
- proestrus vs. male

Visualizations:

- UpSet plot showing unique and shared DEGs across comparisons
- Volcano plots for better visualization of differential expression

---

## 3.3 GO Enrichment

GO analysis on each DEG list.

Expected findings:

- **Estrus vs. proestrus:** synaptic signaling and organization
- **Estrus vs. male:** metabolism-related processes

---

## 3.4 Motif analysis

Reproduce the finding that **TFAP2C** and **EGR1** transcription factor motifs are enriched in:

- bivalent promoters in estrus females (**resilient**)
- permissive promoters in proestrus females and males (**vulnerable**)

using MEME/SEA on group-specific chromatin segments.

---

## 3.5 Extension

Among genes differentially expressed between estrus and proestrus females, test whether those same genes also differ in chromatin state between the two groups.

This would directly link permissive chromatin accessibility to transcriptional output.
